[P2] Return to one supported evidence contract

Rule 2, **Simplify before you add**, remains unmet: this negotiates multiple reader APIs even though `verify_checkout()` permits exactly one revision. Cleanup and summary contain similar compatibility paths without explaining why one fixed interface cannot work. The committed pin also bypasses the new replay policy, and consumer tests conditionally skip unsupported checks. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and agree on one validated producer/reader contract; binding directly to that contract is the simpler direction.
